idea-plugin.name: Octopus Merge
idea-plugin.description:
Merge several Git branches into one with a single merge commit (octopus merge).
  • Pick the target branch and any number of branches to merge, with search
  • Branches selected in the Git tool window are pre-checked
  • Conflicts are resolved in the standard IDE merge dialog, branch by branch; the result is still one commit whose parents are the target and every merged branch

action.description: Merge several branches into one with a single merge commit
